scope: Full default existing example11, unchanged discrete SRFPLL; no complete VSC/C1 claim

record_contract.endpoint_policy: First and last actual values must equal 0 and 1; no clamping or extrapolation.

semantic_gates: Retain all 10001 finite rows and exact 23 columns, actual native control timestamps, t0 and t=1; nominal grid residual <=1e-14s.
At t0 only observe theta0/omega0/xi0; no PI or angle update. Check first three states with the previously frozen observed-Delta closed forms.
Every later old theta/omega/xi/time equals preceding new state/time; started is exactly 0 then 1. Delta is the positive actual difference.
Before unwrapping, reject abs(old_omega*Delta)>=pi. Compute theta from old omega; same-time abc and current theta give dq; new xi enters omega0+(Kp*error+xi_new).
Check all source/Clarke/Park/base/error/mod/state algebraic identities from recorded scalars with startup absolute budgets; do not generate a second recursive reference trajectory.
For all rows preserve the negative mod diagnostic. Only first three errors must equal -1; do not apply this startup identity to later full rows.
Anchor both theta and theta_old streams at the declared theta0; principal increments in (-pi,pi), validate against logged state-chain/old-omega advance. No fitted turns, phase or delay.
native_gates: Before launch freeze per-schedule graph, worker, analyzer, monitor, runtime and input hashes; each run has a separate immutable source and output directory.
Use R2026b existing license and protected SATK read/edit/read/check interfaces. Preserve the 58 standard blocks, 80 connections, 5 delays and 100us control rates.
Use separate named solver_step for 100us or 50us, actual configuration readback, with control_step fixed100us. Protocol-only overrides do not prove a solver change.
Configure and read back all22 signal names/logging-on/SignalName/no-decimation/no-point-limit; Name is a line property, logging settings belong to source output ports.
Use SimulationInput/Output outside try/catch. Save original MAT/SLX and native17digit CSV; all22 Time/Data arrays must be double with identical grids.
Retain and check original out.tout separately as solver_time.csv, exact10001/20001 nominal solver ticks, strict 0/1 coverage, finite double. No invented signal midpoints.
Inspect all actual compiled control sample times [100us,0]. Internal type summaries are not per-port double proof.
Require normal terminal closure, unchanged inputs, all observed owned processes exited, and no monitor or cleanup errors before analysis.
